author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Hardkernel has introduced the ODROID-H5, a new x86 single-board computer based on Intel’s Core i3-N300 processor. The board updates the ODROID H-series with onboard 10GbE networking, four M.2 expansion slots, DDR5 memory support, and a revised HSIO configuration intended for storage, networking, and accelerator expansion. title: ODROID-H5 is a low-power x86 SBC with 10GbE and four M.2 slots
